title: custom:schedule-card-pro
description: A schedule helper's week: a lane per day with its blocks, when it changes next, and an edit mode on the card that saves the week in one call.

name.description: The header's title. Default: the entity's name. Template allowed.

icon.description: The header's icon. Default: the entity's

color.description: The blocks' colour. Default: Home Assistant's for a schedule that is on

data.description: The block data shown on the blocks and in their tooltip, each a key or { key, unit, step, min, max, default }; edit mode's toolbar changes the first one

edit.description: The pencil in the header and a long press on the week turn edit mode on, for administrators and schedules made in the UI; false: view only

snap.description: The minutes a block's times snap to while editing

first_weekday.description: The first day of the week shown. Default: the user's profile

title_tap_action.description: What a tap on the title does (default: nothing)
